facts: g.extra contains max_reference_audio_len and seed, but no temperature.

consequence: The 78-frame / 149760-sample 0012 device WAV is an effective-temperature-0.7 result. Continued 0014 runs tested explicit 0.7 as the physical implementation comparator and preserved earlier explicit-0.3 attempts separately.
